name: brewcrm

scripts.test:e2e: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('coverage/e2e-tmp',{recursive:true,force:true})" && playwright test -c playwright.e2e.config.mjs && npm run coverage:e2e
scripts.coverage:e2e: c8 report --temp-directory coverage/e2e-tmp --include pb_public/app.js --reporter text --reporter lcov --report-dir coverage/e2e --check-coverage --lines 90 --functions 90 --branches 85

description: Lightweight self-hosted sales CRM for small craft breweries
